bridge.note: Spanish wishes you a HAPPY year; Italian wishes you a GOOD one. Italian has 'felice', but the fixed greeting does not use it — buon anno, never felice anno. This buono/feliz split runs through the whole greeting system.

interference.es_to_it: Spanish speakers produce 'felice anno' by direct translation. The fixed form is buon anno.
interference.it_to_es: Italians produce 'buen año'. Spanish says feliz año.
